34 engagements

Healthcare projects attract capital when bed economics, the operator and the offering are designed together.

Healthcare and life sciences account for 34 of the 650+ engagements in HAYKALAH’s archive census, 2004–2026. The work follows HAYKALAH’s healthcare NewCo and capital-raising playbook: bed-based economics, operator partnerships and offering design. In 2010, SAR 186m was raised by private placement in five weeks for a new 100-bed hospital in Jeddah, with HAYKALAH as lead financial adviser.

Archive census counts are indicative. The outcome is recorded in HAYKALAH files.

What we do

  • Market research and feasibility studies for hospitals, clinics and healthcare companies.

  • Bed-based financial models and valuation.

  • Operator partnerships and business plans.

  • Company formation for healthcare NewCos.

  • Capital readiness and support through a raise. Any offer of securities runs through a CMA-authorised institution.

How we create value

  • 03

    Optimization

    For a new 100-bed Jeddah hospital, HAYKALAH’s feasibility study, market research and valuation supported a SAR 186m private placement that closed in five weeks (2010).

  • 06

Questions

What are bed-based economics?

A hospital’s revenue, costs and capital modeled per bed, so that its size and its funding need can be tested before it is built.

Does HAYKALAH raise capital for healthcare projects?

HAYKALAH prepares the feasibility study, the model, the valuation and the business plan that investors review, and advises the company through the raise. Any offer of securities is carried out by a CMA-authorised institution engaged for the transaction.

Tell us about the hospital, the clinic or the healthcare company. We can start under an NDA.
